title: Cold rebuild: scale a StatefulSet
summary: Scale a StatefulSet and find a pod's stable name on a real Kubernetes cluster, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a skill stuck. In *other workloads* you scaled a StatefulSet on a real cluster and found the stable DNS
name of one of its pods. Now do it again from memory: the same scenario, **no hints, no solution to peek at**. The
checks are exactly the ones you passed the first time.
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old commands feels like knowing
them; doing it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: StatefulSet scale-down order. What does this print?
code: for (int i = from - 1; i >= to; i--)
steps.explain: Highest ordinal first. Scaling up creates `db-2`, `db-3` again in ascending order and reattaches their old PVCs.

steps.title: Scale a StatefulSet, cold
